columns.name: EVENT_PROCESS_STAGE_DETAIL_ID
columns.description: The enterprise for which this responsibility applies. Allow multi-tenancy customers.

columns.name: ENTERPRISE_ID
columns.description: Identifier of Enterprise, used for multi-tenancy partitioning. Foreign key to HR_ORGANIZATION_UNITS.

columns.name: EVENT_PROCESS_STAGE_ID
columns.description: Foreign Key to the PER_EVENT_PROCESS_STAGE table

columns.name: PERSON_ID
columns.description: Person ID for which the event has to be raised.

columns.name: EVENT_RAISE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which the event should be raised.

columns.name: EVENT_TYPE
columns.description: Type of the event. valid values  "INSERT", "UPDATE"

columns.name: SOURCE_OBJECT_NAME
columns.description: Source Object Name which fired the event.

columns.name: CHANGED_PERSON_DETAILS_FLAG
columns.description: This flag identifies whether "Changed Person Details Event" should be raised or not.

columns.name: CHANGED_KEYWORDS_FLAG
columns.description: This flag identifies whether "Changed keywords" should be raised or not.

columns.name: CREATION_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the creation of the row.

columns.name: CREATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who created the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_DATE
columns.description: Who column: indicates the date and time of the last update of the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATED_BY
columns.description: Who column: indicates the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: LAST_UPDATE_LOGIN
columns.description: Who column: indicates the session login associated to the user who last updated the row.

columns.name: OBJECT_VERSION_NUMBER
columns.description: Used to implement optimistic locking. This number is incremented every time that the row is updated. The number is compared at the start and end of a transaction to detect whether another session has updated the row since it was queried.

columns.name: PERSON_NUMBER
columns.description: Number assigned to the person, to identify the person uniquely in any context, not dependent on being an employee, contingent worker, etc.
